title: Smoke alarm
prompt: a ceiling smoke alarm: press test, blow smoke into it and it sounds, hush it, replace the battery; see-through shows the photoelectric chamber, LED, photodiode, piezo horn and battery
blurb: Puff test smoke at a ceiling alarm and watch it drift through the labyrinth into the dark chamber, scatter the infrared beam onto the photodiode and set off the piezo horn.
